sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH students AS (
    SELECT
        s.FIRST_NAME,
        s.LAST_NAME,
        s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
        s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        MAX(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (
            ORDER BY s.LAST_NAME
            ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
        ) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME AS STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
      AND s.STUDENT_YEAR LIKE 'G%'
),
subjects AS (
    SELECT
        o.SUBJECT_ID,
        o.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        o.TOTAL_UNITS,
        o.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME,
        SUM(o.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
            ORDER BY o.SUBJECT_ID
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY o
    WHERE o.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
      AND o.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Political Science'
      AND o.TOTAL_UNITS > 1
)
SELECT
    st.FIRST_NAME,
    st.LAST_NAME,
    st.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    st.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    st.SCHOOL_NAME,
    st.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
    su.SUBJECT_ID,
    su.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
        PARTITION BY st.STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME
        ORDER BY su.SUBJECT_ID
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS RUNNING_SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM students st
CROSS JOIN subjects su
ORDER BY st.LAST_NAME, su.SUBJECT_ID;

question_text: For each graduate student in the Political Science department, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, and the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, along with each subject offered in the term '2016SP' with a total number of units greater than 1 in the Political Science department, including the subject ID, subject title, and the running sum of total units within each school name group ordered by subject ID. List all columns in the following order: first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, maximum department budget code, subject ID, subject title, and running sum of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
